planets.name: 55 Cnc f
planets.description: Planet of 55 Cnc found by radial velocity, with a 261-day year, found in 2007.

radius.source: the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc f does not transit

mass.source: Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3: minimum mass (m sin i) 48.5 +/- 2.8 Earth masses from the star's radial velocities; at the assumed tilt of 93.9 degrees the mass is 0.2% more

orbit.source: Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3, a fit of the star's radial velocities, for the period, eccentricity, argument, time of conjunction and semi-major axis (a/R* is its 0.802 au over the star's recorded 656,045 km). The tilt and node are NOT measured for this planet: they are assumed equal to those Xiao et al. (2026, arXiv:2609.01377) measure for 55 Cnc d

text.card: 55 Cnc f was found in 2007 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc; its size is a model. Its tilt is not measured: it is drawn in the plane measured for 55 Cnc d.
text.locator: Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3: P 260.58 d, Tconj 2455236.4, e 0.063, omega 1.75 rad, a 0.802 au, m sin i 48.5 Earth masses; Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4, 55 Cnc d: I 93.9 deg, Omega 124 deg (assumed for this planet); NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table: disc_year 2007, sy_pnum 7, 5 of them with hostname 55 Cnc; pscomppars calculated pl_radj 0.677

quotes.title: 55 Cancri Af
quotes.card: 55 Cancri Af, also designated Rho1 Cancri f and formally named Harriot, is an exoplanet approximately 41 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Cancer.
quotes.introduction: 55 Cancri Af is the fourth-known planet from the star 55 Cancri A and the first planet to have been given the designation of "f".
